research_note: Guides written 19 November 2026, the day after launch, in the author's own words. The main source is the PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com), published 18-19 November 2026; names, descriptions and grades are the official list as carried by PSNProfiles and Exophase. Three trophies were still unconfirmed by every guide on that date and are marked as such in their guides rather than guessed at.

roadmap.title: Step 1 — Play the story (60–80 hours)
roadmap.text: Finish the five-chapter story and enjoy it. All 12 story trophies pop automatically as you play, and progress toward the 100% checklist already counts even though the checklist itself only becomes visible after the story. Do the one thing that matters here: the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see its guide) before Chapter 1 ends, and keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — there is no mission replay. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com).

roadmap.title: Step 2 — Side content alongside the story
roadmap.text: Take the optional questlines as they appear (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret), scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app, study animals with binoculars, and work on stunts, races, shooting ranges, drone races, robberies and collectibles as you travel. Most of the grind trophies are far quicker if started early instead of left to the end. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com).

roadmap.title: Step 3 — Post-story: 100% checklist and cleanup (~100 hours)
roadmap.text: After the story, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work the checklist: it is lenient, closer to 60% true completion, and needs 70 of 80 challenges plus partial collectibles. Then finish the Strangers & Freaks strands and any miscellaneous trophies left over, such as the UFO easter egg and the still-unconfirmed ones once guides pin them down. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com).

roadmap.title: Step 4 — Platinum: Vice Got a Price!
roadmap.text: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. No online play and no DLC are needed; one playthrough is enough, at about 200 hours and 4/10 difficulty according to PowerPyx. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com).

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, so there is no separate task behind it: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Every trophy is single-player and offline, so no multiplayer or DLC is needed, and one playthrough is enough. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, with the 100% completion checklist the longest grind. Finish the story, work the checklist, then clean up the last side trophies and this one follows.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and finish it; the trophy pops automatically when the mission ends. There is nothing extra to do and nothing to miss, since it is the first story mission. Just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full; the trophy unlocks automatically as the story rolls into Chapter 2. Play the chapter's main missions in order and it will pop on its own. No side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2; the trophy pops automatically when the story moves into Chapter 3. Just keep playing the main missions — there are no optional requirements and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3; it unlocks automatically as the story advances into Chapter 4. Main missions only, nothing missable, and no side content is required.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4; the trophy pops automatically when the chapter's final main mission ends. Keep following the story and it comes on its own.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story; the trophy pops when it ends. It is automatic and cannot be missed — simply play the story to its end. PowerPyx notes there is no mission replay, so enjoy the finale; nothing here needs a second run.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2; the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3; it pops automatically at the mission's end. Just play the mission through — no extra objective is needed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4; it unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Story progress only, nothing missable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4; the trophy pops automatically at the end of the mission. Keep playing the main story and it comes on its own.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4; it unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Pure story progress, nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory, late in the story; it pops automatically at the mission's end. PowerPyx places this mission in the final stretch of the story, and like every story trophy it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist, which opens after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion; progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses the checklist is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — with most side quests not required and collectibles only partly required: for example 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and 70 of 80 challenges. Work through the checklist after the story and this gold pops when the last item ticks off; nothing on it is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts out of 397 across Leonida. PowerPyx breaks them into 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps; you can mix categories freely. Track them under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. Under-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up; the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once; check them under Touchpad, Progress, Activities, where scrolling over each type shows how many you have done. The nine are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or drone race, and performing a stunt. Most are introduced by the story or marked with blue dumbbell icons on the map, and you will likely tick them all off naturally while chasing other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. PowerPyx links a dedicated guide to all 12 locations and all 42 gold medals; work through each range's challenges until every one shows gold. The gold thresholds are not brutal, and your Focus skill grows as you practise, which helps.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations; PowerPyx lists 42 drone races across those 14 spots, so one win per location is what counts. Fly the drone courses and finish first at each location to tick it off. If a location's race beats you, retry it — races can be repeated freely.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations, so you have twice as many to choose from as you need. Enter races from the map, win 20 distinct ones, and the trophy pops. Any race type counts, so pick the shortest and easiest courses first.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and out-fish him in the challenge he sets. It stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish all of its levels at least once; bonus challenges are not needed. There are four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, while Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Pick whichever you like best and play it to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is exclusive to Lucia and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Complete her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. The quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline: it gets marked automatically in Chapter 1, and after the mission Island Dreams he calls and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at shipwrecks — seven sets in total — marked with purple chest icons; use the metal detector on the ocean floor, bring the treasures back, and keep returning when he calls with more. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a stretch of the story but returns in Chapters 2-3, so nothing is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline, which is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Complete his five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last. It all stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — PowerPyx confirms Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) among them, while questlines like Moses, Tyrone, Andy and Billy do not count toward this trophy. Find the strangers in the open world, finish their strands, and watch the count on the trophy tracker. All of them remain available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List: it opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City — he marks some on the map, and you can steal others off the street; scanning a car with the WAiNK app shows whether it is on his list. Deliver them in good condition for better pay, and the trophy pops when the list is complete. Track it under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, available only as Jason: it opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, with purple markers for Synthetic Labs around Vice City. Destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, and after enough are gone Tyrone gives you Spin On This, to shut the labs down — completing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, tracked under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. THIS IS THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow and choose Accept. That first meditation becomes unavailable after Chapter 1, so do it before the chapter ends and keep a manual save from Chapter 1 as a backup. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether that first meditation is actually required for the trophy, since it is not marked as a regular spot — but doing it costs nothing and removes the risk.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive it). Meet Bret, who gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, then follow the hunting spots he marks with purple icons and bring the animals he requests back to him. It stays available after the story, and PowerPyx notes the exact animal that pops the trophy is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida and PowerPyx lists 18 card set locations in its collectible guide; gather full sets of cards and the trophy pops when your third set is complete. Check your collection under Progress, Collections, as you go, and work on cards alongside the WAiNK scans and other collectibles.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: hold up on the D-pad to open the WAiNK app, then hold R1 to scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures around you. PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, so there are far more than 100 scannable spots — any 100 will do. Scan as you travel and it will come naturally; the same habit also feeds the vehicle discovery and 100% checklist.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges out of 80; the 100% checklist wants 70, so this pops on the way there. Challenges sit under Progress, Challenges, in eight categories of 10, and many complete themselves while you chase other trophies. When you are near the end, pick the easiest remaining ones — there are 10 more than the checklist needs, so you can skip the hardest.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. You need both characters together, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner with the D-pad and triangle prompt. Cause chaos until you hit 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone on a fast bike; PowerPyx recommends the train tunnel north of Ambrosia, where police and helicopters struggle to follow. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Call your partner, then hit three robbery targets in a row while the flashing wanted level stays active — wear armour, carry sticky bombs and healing items, and loot each shop properly, ideally breaking the safe in the back room. PowerPyx notes the pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and a good spot is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app from your phone and scan vehicles as they pass — scanning is enough, you never need to drive them. The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this pops naturally if you scan new cars, bikes, boats and aircraft as you meet them. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3+R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar. Boost focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, wear body armour, and line up five enemies — gang operation members work best — then drop them quickly with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, and it gets easier as your Focus level rises toward level 4.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — the one at terminals E3/E4 is easiest — board it, get into the cockpit, reverse it to the runway and take off. You must fly about 1 km away from the airport before the trophy pops, so keep flying until it unlocks. Planes parked out on the airfield do not count; it has to be one connected to a boarding bridge.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) and the trophy pops once you are driving it and shooting. Tanks stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank in the south of the base, and fire at the soldiers who respond.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in, find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe without raising the alarm. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape; there are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this pops on the way. Bank vaults open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, where you tail a security van to a bank and slip in while the vault is open — bring your partner to carry a second bag of cash. After that, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 to mark more vans. Each vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch cars to lose the heat.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest route is the same Chapter 4 mission as the bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is… — tailing the truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing the truck. You can also do it earlier: block an armored truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. You need all 8 large bank jobs for 100% anyway, so this usually pops on its own.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: fully unfog the whole map, all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane — fly over every black-fogged part of the map until it all turns visible. It is a long sweep rather than a hard one, so save it for after the story when you can fly freely.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so one per gang comes naturally; they appear as yellow icons when you go near them and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track each gang's count under Progress, Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. HONEST STATUS: as of 19 November 2026 PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, with no confirmed method — no guide has yet pinned down which bar or prompt triggers it. The description itself points to Ocean Beach, so the sensible try is a beachfront bar or cafe on Ocean Beach, ordering a cocktail while facing the view; if it does not pop, wait for the guides to confirm the spot rather than guessing further. This guide will not invent a location it cannot source.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com): listed as currently unknown, 19 Nov 2026; official trophy description (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. You need the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City — and only that car counts, as a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You can only steal it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS: hack into the Banshee, drive forward and straight through the showroom window, and the trophy pops shortly after you reach the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; inside, take the luxury watch from the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun from the north-east table, and blow open the safe in the north-east hallway with sticky bombs (buy them at an Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police — and it is not missable, since the robbery icon respawns and you can return for any valuables you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Strength is checked under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, then Strength (heart icon); you can only work on both once character switching unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Buy a gym membership, always train together — call your partner so the other character trains automatically while you work out — and both bars will climb together. Gyms are marked under Map, Activities, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile; the trophy list itself shows your count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, and a small demon-face icon will flash whenever an action counts. Anything from stealthy robberies and clean escapes to violent rampages counts, with the profile ranging from Professional through Hardened and Violent to Psycho — and Irredeemable, which is permanent and best avoided. It builds passively across every other trophy, so do not farm it until everything else is done.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. HONEST STATUS: as of 19 November 2026 PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. No guide has confirmed the exact trigger, so this guide will not invent one: the name suggests failing something once and succeeding on the second try, and the Payday Loans store is the lead to watch. Check the PowerPyx guide for updates once players confirm it.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com): listed as currently unknown, 19 Nov 2026; official trophy description (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Late at night, after 2 AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back, since the spawn is slightly random. Follow the path from the car into the woods to find the UFO's bright blue light, approach it, and when it drops the woman it abducted, talk to her, offer to help, and return to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. HONEST STATUS: as of 19 November 2026 PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. No guide has confirmed the exact trigger, so do not take the motorcycle-kick theory as fact — it is the current best guess from the trophy's wording. Watch the PowerPyx guide for confirmation.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com): listed as currently unknown, 19 Nov 2026; official trophy description (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills; then rob banks and Payday Loans stores and deliver the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in one job, so it comes naturally while doing the robberies for 100%.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Anything counts, but guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest since they are the most expensive — Ammu-Nations, mod shops, tattoo studios, clothing and electronics stores all add to the total. It is cumulative across the whole game, so it usually pops on its own while you gear up for other trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone; the 8 purchasable garages cost $160,000 in total (4 more garages come from the story and do not count). Buy them all through the phone app — robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4, are the quickest way to raise the cash.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses; it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. You need garage space first — each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages (see Little Boxes) — then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and Register, or register at a Pay 'n' Spray once you can handle tracked cars in Chapter 3. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
